description: ICD-10-CM codes used in AegisHealth-KG prototype scenarios. This is a curated subset — the full ICD-10-CM contains ~70,000 codes.

codes.clinical_notes: Type 2 diabetes mellitus is characterized by insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency. Code E11.9 is used when the diabetes is documented without mention of specific complications (retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy, etc.).
includes: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without mention of complication

related_codes.description: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with unspecified complications
Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with other specified complication

codes.clinical_notes: Used when the diabetes is specifically documented with hyperglycemia that is not a routine part of the diabetes but is specifically noted as a complication or acute finding.

codes.category_description: Other joint disorder, not elsewhere classified
codes.chapter_description: Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue (M00–M99)
codes.clinical_notes: This code is used for knee pain when a more specific underlying cause has not yet been identified. Common use is for initial evaluation before diagnostic imaging. The 6th character '1' specifies the right side.

related_codes.description: Derangement of anterior horn of medial meniscus due to old tear or injury, right knee

codes.description: Derangement of anterior horn of medial meniscus due to old tear or injury, right knee
codes.chapter_description: Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue (M00–M99)
codes.clinical_notes: Specific code for meniscal tear pathology. Typically assigned after imaging (MRI) confirms the diagnosis. In Scenario 2, this would be the expected diagnosis if MRI confirms medial meniscal tear suggested by the positive McMurray test.

codes.description: Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent episode, moderate
codes.clinical_notes: Recurrent major depressive disorder indicates that the patient has experienced multiple depressive episodes. The 'moderate' specifier is based on clinical assessment: more symptoms than needed for minimum diagnosis, moderate intensity, and moderate functional impairment. Corresponds approximately to PHQ-9 scores of 10–19.
includes: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate severity

related_codes.description: Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent, severe without psychotic features
Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent, severe with psychotic features
Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent, in remission, unspecified

codes.description: Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent episode, mild
codes.clinical_notes: Mild recurrent MDD: few symptoms beyond minimum criteria, minor functional impairment. Corresponds to PHQ-9 scores of 5–9.

codes.description: Major Depressive Disorder, recurrent episode, severe without psychotic features
codes.clinical_notes: Severe recurrent MDD: most symptoms present, marked intensity, significant functional impairment. Corresponds to PHQ-9 scores of 20–27.

codes.block_description: Anxiety, dissociative, stress-related, somatoform and other nonpsychotic mental disorders
codes.clinical_notes: Comorbid diagnosis for Scenario 3 patient. GAD frequently co-occurs with MDD.
